cards.zh: 装胶卷这一步必须在全黑的环境里做
cards.en: You have to [[load the film onto the reel]] in total darkness.
cards.mine: Put the film into the tank in the dark.
cards.note: reel 是显影罐里的片轴，胶卷先绕上片轴，再放进 developing tank（显影罐）

cards.zh: 先用开瓶器把胶卷暗盒撬开
cards.en: [[Crack open the canister]] with a bottle opener.
cards.note: canister / cassette 是装胶卷的小铁盒（暗盒），box 是外面的纸盒

cards.zh: 没有暗房的话，可以用换片袋
cards.en: If there's no darkroom, you can use a [[changing bag]].
cards.note: changing bag 换片袋：有两个袖口，手伸进去在里面操作

cards.zh: 先把片头剪平，这样比较好上片轴
cards.en: [[Trim the leader]] so it feeds onto the reel smoothly.
cards.mine: Cut the head of the film.
cards.note: leader 片头，就是露在暗盒外面那一小截

cards.zh: 盖子盖好以后罐子就不透光了，可以开灯
cards.en: Once the lid's on, the tank is [[light-tight]], so you can turn the lights on.
cards.note: light-tight 不透光，也常说 light-proof

cards.zh: 冲黑白胶卷主要用三种药水：显影液、停显液、定影液
cards.en: The three main chemicals are [[developer, stop bath and fixer]].
cards.mine: Developing water, stopping water and fixing water.
cards.note: developer 显影液，stop bath 停显液，fixer 定影液

cards.zh: 显影液要按一比九兑水
cards.en: [[Dilute the developer]] one to nine with water.
cards.note: dilute 稀释。1+9 读作 one plus nine 或 one to nine

cards.zh: 查一下这款胶卷在 20 度时的显影时间
cards.en: Look up the [[development time]] for this film at 20 degrees.
cards.note: development time 显影时间，常查 Massive Dev Chart。温度越高，时间越短

us.en: Look up the [[development time]] for this film at 68 degrees.
us.note: 美国常用华氏度，20°C 约等于 68°F

cards.zh: 前 30 秒连续翻转，之后每分钟翻四次
cards.en: [[Agitate]] for the first 30 seconds, then do four inversions every minute.
cards.note: agitate 搅动（让药水均匀），inversion 把罐子倒过来再翻回去

cards.zh: 在桌上敲一敲罐子，把气泡赶走
cards.en: [[Tap the tank]] on the bench to knock off any air bubbles.
cards.mine: Hit the tank on the table.
cards.note: tap 轻敲。气泡粘在胶片上会留下小圆点

cards.zh: 把显影液倒掉，再倒进停显液
cards.en: [[Pour out the developer]] and pour in the stop bath.
cards.note: pour out / pour off 倒出来。有的显影液是一次性的，有的可以回收，听老师的

cards.zh: 定影五分钟以后，就可以打开罐子了
cards.en: [[Fix]] for five minutes, then you can open the tank.
cards.mine: Do the fixing for five minutes.
cards.note: fix 当动词就是定影。定影完成前打开，胶片会被光毁掉

cards.zh: 用流水冲洗十分钟
cards.en: [[Wash the film]] under running water for ten minutes.
cards.note: wash 水洗，把残留的定影液洗干净，底片才能保存很久

cards.zh: 最后加几滴润湿剂，防止留下水痕
cards.en: Add a few drops of [[wetting agent]] to stop water spots.
cards.note: wetting agent 润湿剂，常见牌子 Photo-Flo。别用洗洁精

cards.zh: 把底片挂在没灰尘的地方晾干
cards.en: [[Hang the negatives up to dry]] somewhere dust-free.
cards.note: negatives 底片（负片）。晾的时候底下夹个夹子，防止卷起来

cards.zh: 这卷底片太薄了，可能显影不足
cards.en: These negatives look [[thin]]; they're probably underdeveloped.
cards.note: thin 薄（影像很淡），对应 underdeveloped 显影不足 / underexposed 曝光不足

cards.zh: 这卷特别厚，可能是过曝了
cards.en: This roll is really [[dense]]; maybe it was overexposed.
cards.note: dense 厚、密度高，对应 overexposed 过曝 / overdeveloped 显影过度

cards.zh: 我是按 1600 拍的，所以要推一档冲
cards.en: I shot it at 1600, so I need to [[push it one stop]].
cards.mine: Develop it longer by one level.
cards.note: push 增感冲洗（加长显影），pull 减感冲洗。stop 是一档

cards.zh: 前面几张有漏光
cards.en: There's a [[light leak]] on the first few frames.
cards.note: light leak 漏光，frame 一张底片、一格画面

cards.zh: 把底片剪成六张一条，放进底片袋
cards.en: [[Cut the negatives into strips]] of six and put them in a sleeve.
cards.note: strip 一条，negative sleeve 底片袋

cards.zh: 先印一张印样，看看所有画面
cards.en: Let's make a [[contact sheet]] first to see all the frames.
cards.note: contact sheet 印样（小样），底片直接压在相纸上曝光

cards.zh: 放大的时候可以开安全灯，装胶卷时不行
cards.en: You can switch on the [[safelight]] for printing, but not for loading film.
cards.note: safelight 安全灯（通常是红色或琥珀色）。相纸对它不敏感，胶卷会被它弄坏

cards.zh: 底片放进片夹时，药膜面朝下
cards.en: Put the negative in the carrier [[emulsion side down]].
cards.note: emulsion 药膜面（不反光的那面），朝下对着相纸。carrier 是放大机的底片夹

cards.zh: 用对焦器把颗粒对清楚
cards.en: Use the [[grain focuser]] to get the grain sharp.
cards.note: grain focuser 对焦器，grain 颗粒。对到颗粒清楚，照片就清楚

cards.zh: 先做一张试条，找出合适的曝光时间
cards.en: Do a [[test strip]] to find the right exposure time.
cards.note: test strip 试条：一张相纸分段曝光，比如每段多 3 秒

cards.zh: 天空那里多加几秒光
cards.en: [[Burn in]] the sky for a few extra seconds.
cards.note: burn / burn in 加光（局部加长曝光，变暗）

cards.zh: 把阴影部分遮一下，不要太黑
cards.en: [[Dodge]] the shadows a bit so they don't go too dark.
cards.note: dodge 遮挡减光（局部减少曝光，变亮），和 burn 正好相反

cards.zh: 想要反差大一点，就换三号滤镜
cards.en: Use a [[grade 3 filter]] for more contrast.
cards.note: 多级反差相纸（variable contrast / multigrade）配滤镜，号数越大反差越大

cards.zh: RC 相纸比纤维相纸干得快多了
cards.en: [[Resin-coated paper]] dries much faster than fibre paper.
cards.note: resin-coated (RC) 涂塑相纸，fibre-based 纤维相纸（质感更好，但难处理）

us.en: [[Resin-coated paper]] dries much faster than fiber paper.

cards.zh: 轻轻晃动药盘，让照片显影均匀
cards.en: Gently [[rock the tray]] so the print develops evenly.
cards.note: tray 药盘，print 洗出来的照片

cards.zh: 用夹子，别把手伸进药水里
cards.en: Use the [[tongs]], don't put your hands in the chemicals.
cards.note: tongs 夹子。每个药盘用自己的夹子，别混用

cards.zh: 定影液不能倒进水槽，要倒进回收桶
cards.en: Don't [[pour the fixer down the sink]]; it goes in the waste container.
cards.mine: Don't throw the fixer in the sink.
cards.note: 用过的定影液里有银，要回收处理
